products.title: Royal Delight Duo ( Min 5 Boxes)
products.body_html:
2 in 1 Small Gift Box – Badam Pak & Walnut Sohan Halwa
A delightful duo of traditional sweets in a beautifully packed gift box!

This charming 2 in 1 Small Gift Box includes two rich and flavorful delicacies:

  • Badam Pak – A soft, nutritious sweet made with premium almonds, offering a taste of tradition in every bite.

  • Walnut Sohan Halwa – A delicious twist on the classic sohan halwa, enriched with crunchy walnuts and a hint of caramelized sweetness.

This box is the perfect way to share joy — whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply want to make someone feel special.

✅ Handcrafted with care
✅ Fresh and hygienically packed
✅ Ideal for gifting on Eid, birthdays, or as a corporate treat

products.title: Mix Nimco
products.body_html: Our Mix Nimko is made using time-tested recipes, offering a delightful taste of Pakistan's culinary heritage.

products.title: Gujiya
products.body_html: We use generous portions of melt-in-your-mouth khoya and Desi Ghee to create a luxuriously rich and creamy filling.

products.title: Simple Patisa
products.body_html: Indulge in the timeless taste of Rewari Sweet Mart's Simple Patisa Made with pure desi ghee for an unmatched richness, this delightful treat is a perfect balance of sweet and savory. Each bite offers a satisfying crunch followed by the creamy melt-in-your-mouth texture Patisa is known for.

products.title: Milky Patisa
products.body_html: Indulge in the irresistible taste of Rewari Sweet Mart's Milky Patisa This decadent treat is crafted with the finest ingredients, offering a perfect balance of creamy milk and the aromatic nuttiness of real pista.

products.title: Daal Patisa
products.body_html: Indulge in our delectable Dal Patisa, a traditional sweet treat crafted with the finest ingredients. Made with pure desi ghee, for that rich, aromatic flavor, these golden discs are cooked to crispy perfection. Each bite offers a delightful textural contrast - the satisfying crunch of the lentil base and the smooth, buttery richness of the ghee.

products.title: Simple Barfi
products.body_html: We use only pure desi ghee, known for its rich aroma and flavor, to elevate the barfi's texture and taste.

products.title: Shahi Pera
products.body_html: The base of our Shahi Pera is made with rich, melt-in-your-mouth khoya, providing a creamy and luxurious texture. We then add a touch of our famous Rewari Sohan Halwa, infusing each bite with a delightful crunch and the unmistakable flavor of caramelized sohan halwa

products.title: Roll Barfi
products.body_html: Indulge in the delightful decadence of our Roll Barfi, a traditional sweet made with the finest ingredients and generations-old expertise. This melt-in-your-mouth treat features a rich, flaky center made from pure khoya. We use only the most premium desi ghee to create its signature flavor and texture, resulting in a barfi that's both rich and incredibly flavorful.

products.title: Paan Pera
products.body_html: we use only the finest ingredients to create our delectable sweets. Our Paan Mera Barfi is made with pure khoya, ensuring a rich and creamy texture.

products.title: Kaju Katli
products.body_html: The rich taste of tradition with Rewari Sweet Mart's Kaju Katli, crafted with the finest ingredients and pure desi ghee. Each bite is a symphony of textures - a delicate melt-in-your-mouth experience followed by a satisfying crunch of real cashews.

products.title: Dry Fruit Barfi
products.body_html: Our Royal Dry Fruit Barfi is made with rich, melt-in-your-mouth khoya simmered in pure desi ghee for a truly luxurious experience. Bursting with flavor and texture, this barfi is generously studded with a delightful trio of dry fruits

products.title: Chocolate Barfi
products.body_html: Indulge in a delightful fusion of tradition and decadence with Rewari Sweet Mart's Desi Ghee Chocolate Barfi. This exquisite treat combines the rich, chocolatey aroma of pure desi ghee with premium chocolate's smooth, luxurious taste, creating an unforgettable taste sensation.

products.title: Besan Barfi
products.body_html: Indulge in the rich, nutty sweetness of Rewari Sweet Mart's Besan Barfi, a traditional Pakistani sweet made with two simple ingredients premium desi ghee and freshly ground besan.

products.title: Pista Halwa
products.body_html: Crafted with pure desi ghee and real khoya, our Pista Halwa boasts a rich, creamy texture and a delightful pistachio flavor.

products.title: Panjeeri
products.body_html: Experience the rich tradition and wholesome goodness of our Panjeeri, made with the finest ingredients for an irresistible taste and a powerful nutritional punch.

products.title: Makhan Toffee
products.body_html: Savor the rich taste of our Makhan Toffee, made with authentic ingredients like khoya, desi ghee, and almonds.

products.title: Khajoor Halwa
products.body_html: Crafted with Desi Ghee for richness and khoya for creaminess, our Khajour Halwa is a luxurious treat. Finely chopped khajour, almonds and pistachios add delightful texture.

products.title: Kaju Halwa
products.body_html: Luxuriate in our Kaju Halwa, a rich Pakistani dessert made of cashews with desi ghee, khoya, and cashews, garnished with kaju and pistachios.

products.title: Injeer Halwa
products.body_html: Indulge in Injeer Halwa, a rich Pakistani dessert made with Desi Ghee, sun-ripened figs, milk, and a touch of honey. Topped with pistachios for an elegant touch.

products.title: Honey Dry Fruit Halwa
products.body_html: A delightful treat made with the finest ingredients, our Honey Dry Fruit Halwa is a perfect blend of taste and tradition. Each bite bursts with the natural sweetness of pure honey, the rich aroma of Desi Ghee, and the delightful crunch of a variety of nuts and dried fruits.

products.title: Dry Fruit Gajak
products.body_html: Shatteringly crisp Gajak gives way to a luxuriously rich center of Desi Ghee, studded with Kaju, Pista, and Badam for an unforgettable taste sensation.

products.title: Dodh Maisu
products.body_html: Savor the rich taste of our Dodh Maisu made with milk and Desi Ghee, topped with Pista and badam for a delightful texture.

products.title: Badam Paak
products.body_html: Savor the rich, nutty flavor of our Badam Paak, made with real almonds and the aromatic goodness of desi ghee.

products.title: Arbi Halwa
products.body_html: luxurious treat with a melt-in-your-mouth black date sweetness, and rich desi ghee. Topped with cashews, almonds, and pistachios for a delightful crunch.

products.title: Tikki Pack Sohan Halwa
products.body_html: Embark on a delightful discovery of Sohan Halwa in a convenient and irresistible Tikki Pack! Each bite-sized piece bursts with the rich tradition of this delectable sweet, crafted with only the finest ingredients.

products.title: Simple Sohan Halwa
products.body_html: Crafted with tradition, our Sohan Halwa starts with fresh milk, enriched with desi ghee for a luxurious taste. A touch of cardamom adds intrigue, while a cascade of almonds provides a delightful crunch.

products.title: Shahi Sohan Halwa
products.body_html: Made with 100% pure desi ghee, our Shahi Sohan Halwa delivers a rich, buttery flavor that melts in your mouth.

products.title: Dry Fruit Sohan Halwa
products.body_html: Our Dry Fruit Sohan Halwa features a velvety desi ghee or milk base, and delicately cardamom, brimming with a joyous cast of kaju, pista, and badam. Each mouthful is a delightful explosion of textures and tastes.

products.title: Akhroti Sohan Halwa
products.body_html: Indulge in luxury with our Akhroti Sohan Halwa. Made with milk, desi ghee, cardamom, and walnuts, it's garnished with even more nuts for a decadent experience.
